local_dishes.name: Kafuli
local_dishes.description: One of Uttarakhand's signature dishes — a nutritious gravy made from spinach and local leafy greens, traditionally slow-cooked with spices and served with rice.

local_dishes.name: Chainsoo
local_dishes.description: A traditional Garhwali delicacy prepared using roasted black gram lentils. Rich, earthy, and packed with flavour. Typically enjoyed with steamed rice and considered one of the region's comfort foods.

local_dishes.name: Aloo Ke Gutke
local_dishes.description: A beloved Uttarakhand snack made with boiled potatoes sautéed in mustard oil and local spices. Simple yet flavourful, often served alongside tea or traditional meals.

local_dishes.name: Jhangora Ki Kheer
local_dishes.description: A wholesome Himalayan dessert made from barnyard millet, milk, and dry fruits. Light and mildly sweet, offering a unique taste of the region's traditional cuisine.

local_dishes.name: Vegetable Momos
local_dishes.description: One of the most popular Himalayan street foods — steamed dumplings filled with fresh vegetables and served with spicy chutney.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Kalsang Veg Green, Yeti – The Himalayan Kitchen, Kalsang Friends Corner

local_dishes.name: Thukpa
local_dishes.description: A comforting Tibetan noodle soup packed with vegetables and aromatic flavours. Perfect for Mussoorie's cool mountain weather.
local_dishes.where_to_try: Kalsang Veg Green, Yeti – The Himalayan Kitchen, Kalsang Friends Corner

local_dishes.name: Paneer Tikka
local_dishes.description: Fresh cottage cheese marinated with aromatic spices and grilled in a traditional tandoor until perfectly charred.

local_dishes.name: Dal Makhani
local_dishes.description: A rich and creamy lentil preparation slow-cooked overnight, making it one of North India's most loved comfort dishes.

local_dishes.name: Stuffed Kulcha with Chole
local_dishes.description: A hearty North Indian favourite featuring soft stuffed bread paired with flavourful chickpea curry.

local_dishes.name: Buransh Juice
local_dishes.description: A refreshing local drink made from Himalayan rhododendron flowers. Known for its vibrant colour and mildly sweet flavour, unique to Uttarakhand.

local_dishes.name: Traditional Masala Chai
local_dishes.description: A hot cup of spiced tea that complements the cool mountain air, best enjoyed with scenic valley views.
